judgment_text:
ORDER

This writ petition has been filed seeking a direction to the respondents 1 to 6 to take appropriate action against respondents 7 to 11, restraining them from indulging in sectarian activities aimed at excommunicating the petitioner and his family members from the rest of the village community, and consequently to permit the petitioner's family members to worship the deity and participate in the rituals of the festival of Sri Mahakaliamman Public Temple situated at Malvarpatti, Vedasandur Taluk, Dindigul District, along with others, based on the petitioner's representation dated 23-3-2026.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the private respondents are preventing the petitioners from participating in the temple festival and also refusing to receive the temple tax from the petitioner.

3. The learned government advocate appearing for the official respondents submitted that the petitioner's representation has already been received. The petitioner and the villagers appeared for an enquiry, wherein she herself withdrew the complaint and resolved the issue, agreeing that the petitioner and all others are permitted to participate in the temple festival.

4. Heard the learned counsel on either sides and carefully perused the materials placed before this Court. Considering the nature of the order proposed to be passed in this writ petition, notice to the private respondents is dispensed with.

5. In view of the submission made by the learned government advocate appearing for the respondent police, it is made clear that the private respondents shall not hinder the petitioner or any of the villagers from participating in the temple festival hereafter. However, this Court directs that the sixth respondent police and the fifth respondent Tahsildar shall ensure the participation of the petitioner and all village members and also facilitate them in paying their respective temple tax.

6. With the above directions, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
